# 2 Chronicles Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hezekiah reigned son-of twenty-and-five years and-twenty-and-nine years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Abijah daughter-of Zechariah.

**2** And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-all that did David his-father.

**3** He in-year the-first of-his-reign in-the-month the-first opened doors-of house-of YHWH and-he-repaired-them.

**4** And-he-brought the-priests and-the-Levites and-he-gathered-them to-the-square the-eastern.

**5** And-he-said to-them hear-me the-Levites now consecrate-yourselves and-consecrate house-of YHWH God-of your-fathers and-bring-out the-impurity from the-holy-place.

**6** For were-unfaithful our-fathers and-they-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH our-God and-they-forsook-Him and-they-turned their-faces from-dwelling-of YHWH and-they-gave back.

**7** Also they-shut doors-of the-porch and-they-extinguished the-lamps and-incense not they-burned and-burnt-offering not they-offered in-the-holy-place to-God-of Israel.

**8** And-there-was wrath-of YHWH upon Judah and-Jerusalem and-He-gave-them for-horror for-astonishment and-for-hissing as-you are-seeing with-your-eyes.

**9** And-behold fell our-fathers by-the-sword and-our-sons and-our-daughters and-our-wives are-in captivity for-this.

**10** Now it-is with my-heart to-cut a-covenant for-YHWH God-of Israel and-it-will-turn from-us burning-of His-anger.

**11** My-sons now do-not be-negligent for in-you chose YHWH to-stand before-Him to-serve-Him and-to-be to-Him servants and-ones-burning-incense.

**12** And-they-arose the-Levites Mahath son-of Amasai and-Joel son-of Azariah from-sons-of the-Kohathites and-from-sons-of Merari Kish son-of Abdi and-Azariah son-of Jehallelel and-from-the-Gershonites Joah son-of Zimmah and-Eden son-of Joah

**13** and-from-sons-of Elizaphan Shimri and-Jeiel and-from-sons-of Asaph Zechariah and-Mattaniah

**14** and-from-sons-of Heman Jehiel and-Shimei and-from-sons-of Jeduthun Shemaiah and-Uzziel.

**15** And-they-gathered their-brothers and-they-consecrated-themselves and-they-came according-to-commandment-of the-king in-words-of YHWH to-purify house-of YHWH.

**16** And-they-came the-priests inside house-of YHWH to-purify and-they-brought-out all the-uncleanness that they-found in-temple-of YHWH to-court-of house-of YHWH and-they-received the-Levites to-bring-out to-brook Kidron to-the-outside.

**17** And-they-began on-the-first of-the-month the-first to-consecrate and-in-day eight of-the-month they-came to-porch-of YHWH and-they-consecrated house-of YHWH in-days eight and-in-day sixteen of-the-month the-first they-finished.

**18** And-they-came inside to Hezekiah the-king and-they-said we-have-purified all house-of YHWH and-altar-of the-burnt-offering and-all its-vessels and-table-of the-arrangement and-all its-vessels.

**19** And-all the-vessels that cast-away the-king Ahaz in-his-reign in-his-unfaithfulness we-have-prepared and-we-have-consecrated and-behold-them before altar-of YHWH.

**20** And-he-rose-early Hezekiah the-king and-he-gathered the-officials-of the-city and-he-went-up to-house-of YHWH.

**21** And-they-brought bulls seven and-rams seven and-lambs seven and-goats seven for-a-sin-offering for the-kingdom and-for-the-sanctuary and-for-Judah and-he-said to-sons-of Aaron the-priests to-offer on altar-of YHWH.

**22** And-they-slaughtered the-cattle and-they-received the-priests the-blood and-they-dashed on-the-altar and-they-slaughtered the-rams and-they-dashed the-blood on-the-altar and-they-slaughtered the-lambs and-they-dashed the-blood on-the-altar.

**23** And-they-brought the-goats the-sin-offering before the-king and-the-assembly and-they-laid their-hands upon-them.

**24** And-they-slaughtered-them the-priests and-they-made-a-sin-offering with-their-blood on the-altar to-atone for all Israel for for-all Israel said the-king the-burnt-offering and-the-sin-offering.

**25** And-he-stationed the-Levites in-house-of YHWH with-cymbals with-harps and-with-lyres according-to-commandment-of David and-Gad seer-of the-king and-Nathan the-prophet for by-hand-of YHWH was the-commandment by-hand-of His-prophets.

**26** And-they-stood the-Levites with-instruments-of David and-the-priests with-the-trumpets.

**27** And-he-said Hezekiah to-offer the-burnt-offering on the-altar and-at-time began the-burnt-offering began song-of YHWH and-the-trumpets and-upon hands-of instruments-of David king-of Israel.

**28** And-all the-assembly worshiping and-the-song singing and-the-trumpets blowing all this until was-complete the-burnt-offering.

**29** And-as-finishing to-offer they-bowed the-king and-all the-found with-him and-they-worshiped.

**30** And-he-said Hezekiah the-king and-the-princes to-the-Levites to-praise to-YHWH in-words-of David and-Asaph the-seer and-they-praised to-joy and-they-bowed and-they-worshiped.

**31** And-he-answered Hezekiah and-he-said now you-have-filled your-hand to-YHWH approach and-bring sacrifices and-thank-offerings to-house-of YHWH and-they-brought the-assembly sacrifices and-thank-offerings and-every willing-of heart burnt-offerings.

**32** And-it-was number-of the-burnt-offering that brought the-assembly cattle seventy rams a-hundred lambs two-hundred for-burnt-offering to-YHWH all these.

**33** And-the-consecrated-things cattle six-hundred and-sheep three-thousand.

**34** Only the-priests were-too-few and-not they-could to-skin all the-burnt-offerings and-they-strengthened-them their-brothers the-Levites until was-complete the-work and-until consecrated-themselves the-priests for the-Levites were-more upright-of heart to-consecrate-themselves than-the-priests.

**35** And-also burnt-offerings for-abundance with-fat-of the-peace-offerings and-with-drink-offerings for-the-burnt-offering and-was-established service-of house-of YHWH.

**36** And-he-rejoiced Hezekiah and-all the-people over the-preparing God for-the-people for suddenly was the-thing.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **29:3**: in-year the-first in-the-month the-first opened doors — Hezekiah's first royal act reverses Ahaz's last: opening what his father closed. The symbolic power is unmistakable.

- **29:11**: My-sons do-not be-negligent — Hezekiah addresses the Levites as 'my sons,' combining royal authority with pastoral urgency.

- **29:24**: for all Israel — Hezekiah's atonement is explicitly for 'all Israel,' not merely Judah. He claims national scope for his reform, including the fallen northern kingdom.

- **29:34**: the-Levites were-more upright-of heart — A rare rebuke of the priestly establishment: the Levites outperformed the priests in readiness to consecrate themselves.


— EMET
